section.content: 本发明涉及半导体集成电路。本发明的个目的是在内部时钟的频率的设置可动态地改变的LSI中不安装大规模电路的情况下，减小用于根据内部时钟频率改变内部电路的操作模式的程序的负担。在包括根据所供应的参数从时钟源生成内部时钟的内部时钟生成电路的LSI中，提供存储时钟源的频率信息的寄存器、存储参数的寄存器、以及具有多种操作模式的内部电路、控制与从寄存器供应的频率信息和参数相关联的内部电路的操作模式的表单电路。

The present invention relates to semiconductor integrated circuit.In the case of large-scale circuit not being installed in the LSI being dynamically varied it is an object of the invention to the setting of the frequency of clock internally, reduce the burden of the program for the operator scheme according to internal clock frequencies change internal circuit.In the LSI of the internal clock generation circuit including generating internal clocking from clock source according to the parameter supplied, there is provided the register of the frequency information in store clock source, the list circuit for the operator scheme for storing the register of parameter and there is the internal circuit of multiple modes of operation, the control internal circuit associated with the frequency information and parameter supplied from register.

Technical field

The present invention relates to a kind of semiconductor integrated circuit, and especially, be applicable to can by register setting come Adjust operating frequency and the semiconductor integrated circuit of operator scheme can also be changed.

Background technology

In the semiconductor integrated circuit (LSI of such as microcomputer：Large scale integrated circuit) in, exist have to carry out it is all Such as the situation for the high speed processing that high-speed data calculates, and and there is also the situation without high speed processing, such as such as outside Under the holding state of interruption.Therefore, and in the case where performing high speed processing by program using high-frequency clock and and for drop The use pattern that the purpose of low-power consumption is switched to low-speed clock in the standby state is universal.

Therefore, the hardware of microcomputer is constructed in order to by the internal clock and handover operation for generating polytype frequency The method of clock suitably changes the frequency of operating clock.For example, given birth to for the oscillator by internal installation or outside installation Into clock high-frequency clock is generated by using PLL (phaselocked loop), and and low-speed clock is generated by frequency-dividing clock.Also The low-speed clock that generation is generated by multiple oscillators of such as 32kHz oscillators for clock.When microcomputer has operation The construction that clock frequency can suitably be switched by program.

As described above, microcomputer must be operated by the clock of the various frequencies from low-speed clock to high-frequency clock.When Adjust internal circuit transistor current driving ability so as to perform high speed operation and also can under low-speed clock by When the ability performs operation, transistor, which has, is more than the required current driving ability in the range of low-speed clock, and power is imitated Rate deteriorates.In order to solve the problem and reduce power consumption, routinely, such as various measures have been employed.

(1) under low-speed clock, the voltage of internal step down voltage redulator is reduced to suppress power consumption.

(2) under low-speed clock, reduce the electric current deliverability of internal step down voltage redulator or reduce its quantity and adjusted with reducing Save the fixed current of device.

(3) internally in memory, when being operated under high-frequency clock, sense amplifier operates to carry out high fast reading all the time Take.When being operated under low-speed clock, sense amplifier only operates when generating read requests.

On the other hand, the frequency (low high) of detection clock signal of supply outside semiconductor integrated circuit is set forth below The supply voltage of internal circuit or the technology of change operation are supplied to scope and change.

In patent document 1, a kind of integrated circuit is disclosed, it has the electricity of the frequency as detection input clock signal The differential circuit of road means, integrating circuit and comparator.Input clock signal by differential circuit differential and then, integrating Resulting signal is handled in circuit to export the voltage level depending on frequency.By comparator comparison voltage level with making a reservation for Level.When inputting standard time clock, frequency is higher, therefore the output level of integrating circuit is higher and exceed predetermined level.It is another Aspect, when input for test clock when, frequency is relatively low, therefore the output level of integrating circuit is relatively low and no more than predetermined Level.By according to the output of comparator between normal manipulation mode and test pattern switching operation modes, become to enter One step supplying mode switched terminal, and number of terminals will not be increased.

In patent document 2, a kind of IC apparatus is disclosed, it, which has according to the service speed of system to change, supplies Should be to the operating voltage switching device of the operating voltage of functional circuit blocks.Operating voltage switching device has detection input clock The frequency detection circuit of frequency, the multiple operating voltages of generation low-voltage power circuit and selected according to the frequency detected The power selection circuit of operating voltage.

In patent document 3, a kind of semiconductor device is disclosed, it can be by determining according to input clock synchronizing signal Operation is high speed operation or low-speed handing and switches internal circuit and can be adapted to any high speed operation and low power consumption operation.Half Conductor device includes the clock forming circuit of internal clocking of the input clock generation with predetermined phase relation for supply, base The determination circuit in the cycle of input clock is determined in the internal signal of clock forming circuit, and according to the determination knot for determining circuit The internal circuit of fruit switching operation modes.

The content of the invention

In semiconductor integrated circuit, especially, in the conventional semiconductor integrated circuit of such as microcomputer, by posting Storage setting etc., can dynamically change operating frequency in relative broad range.Internal circuit tool in this semiconductor integrated circuit The various operator schemes of with good grounds operating frequency, and the operating frequency can be set by register freely to change.Deposit Device, which is set, to be set with assigned operation frequency and register to specify the operator scheme both of which of internal circuit being performed Carried out in program.But because the operator scheme of internal circuit must be appropriate in association with the change of the setting of operating frequency The problem of changing, therefore programmer being present over-burden.

In order to suitably set the operator scheme of internal circuit, it is necessary to the accurate operating frequency for being extracted in time point.However, hair Now due to during the generations of multiple and more times of interruptions, generation etc. of abnormality processing and the program that changes perform, begin each time It is white elephant for programmer accurately to extract operating frequency eventually.It has also been found that another problem, even if when inside When circuit is set high to the operator scheme of operating frequency within the operating frequency relatively low cycle, from the viewpoint of function, circuit Normal operating, therefore can not easily detect the deterioration of power efficiency.For example, deteriorated when power efficiency in the program development stage When program verification is carried out under state, and being subsequently found power efficiency deterioration problem, in many cases, it is necessary to suitably change Become after operator scheme is set and carry out program verification again.

In order to further reduce the power wastage of semiconductor integrated circuit, the behaviour for internal circuit of more subtly reallocating be present The trend of operation mode.Accordingly, there exist the burden of programmer to become heavier trend.

In order to solve the above problems, by using the technology described in patent document 1,2 and 3, it is expected to measure operating frequency, And it automatically (spontaneously) can suitably change the operator scheme of internal circuit.Therefore the present inventor demonstrates patent Document 1,2 and 3 is concurrent existing following new the problem of.

Technology described in patent document 1, which is related to, to differentiate two kinds of operator schemes (just by the way that input clock frequency is (high/low) Norm formula and test pattern) circuit.Because the frequency as threshold value is specified by the circuit constant of differential circuit and integrating circuit, The circuit scale that thus be accordingly used in determination is larger.If determining operating frequency in multistage, circuit scale further increases.

In technology described in patent document 2, although frequency range can be detected in multistage because device by mainly by What counting circuit, the constant voltage generating circuit of the multiple analog voltage levels of generation and comparison circuit (voltage selecting circuit) formed Frequency detection circuit forms, therefore circuit scale is larger.

And in the technology described in patent document 3, it is necessary to which installation generation is with the input clock relative to supply The clock forming circuit and determination circuit of the internal clocking of predetermined phase relation.

In order to measure or determine operating frequency, pass through above-mentioned any technology, it is necessary to large-scale circuit is installed, and this leads Cause the increase of circuit scale.

It will be described below for solving the means of this problem.From the explanation of specification and accompanying drawing will make other problemses and Novel feature becomes apparent.

Embodiment is as follows.

Including internal clock generation circuit of the parameter according to supply from clock source generation internal clocking, store clock source Frequency information register, store parameter register and with multiple modes of operation internal circuit semiconductor collection Into in circuit, the operator scheme of the supply control internal circuit associated with the frequency information and parameter supplied from register List circuit.

The effect obtained by the embodiment will be briefly explained below.

That is, because in the case where being fitted without the large-scale circuit of such as frequency measurement circuit and frequency determining circuit root Change the operator scheme of internal circuit according to internal clock frequencies, therefore the burden of program can be reduced.
